subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-08-03
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/connect/google-business-profile-mcp (new)New connector landing page — TL;DR, 3-step Google OAuth connect flow, 5 example Claude prompts, real metrics (search/maps impressions, calls, direction requests, website clicks, review count), 5 FAQs, full HowTo + FAQPage + WebPage schema. This is the 5th and final of the 6 Google-source connector pages the strategy called for (GA4, Google Ads, Search Console, YouTube already live) — closes a gap open since Week 4 of the plan. Also cross-linked from the other 4 connector pages, which already promised "the same grant unlocks Business Profile" but had nowhere to point.Google Business Profile MCP (emerging MCP cluster — 0 recorded search volume yet, same as when Search Console MCP shipped at 30/mo; real current demand captured in-copy: "google business profile api", 390/mo, KD 14, US)askarlo.app/connect/google-business-profile-mcp

Needs your attention (unchanged, now 6 sessions old): catalog.ts still marks Meta Ads/HubSpot/Mailchimp/MailerLite coming_soon and Salesforce/Pipedrive waitlist, with Meta Ads' and HubSpot's own etas now past due in the catalog copy itself. Blocks a Meta Ads MCP page and 8 others until you make a call on which are actually ready.

Needs your attention (unchanged): the dormant 6-persona route.ts/_content/_shell.html scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and GSC sitemap submission (open since kickoff, 2026-07-04) both still need a human decision/access this sandbox doesn't have.

Next: the connector matrix is now caught up to the full 6-Google-source plan — no more connector pages queued until a coming_soon/waitlist platform flips to live, or a long-tail variant (a "claude mcp server" pillar page, or a ChatGPT-assistant column) gets scoped. Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 and is now the single most overdue item on the whole plan — needs a human with a browser, this sandbox has no outbound HTTP. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
